description: Preferred. Accepts the widest URI mix (track, album, episode, show, audiobook, artist, user, playlist) in one request. Check whether items are saved in or followed by the user — this tests LIBRARY-SAVED/FOLLOWED state, distinct from check_following_artists which only tests artist FOLLOW state. Returns a boolean per URI via Spotify's unified endpoint. Max 40. Following an artist is no longer expressible: Spotify's February 2026 changes removed PUT/DELETE /me/following, and this endpoint's save side does not accept spotify:artist: URIs, so there is no endpoint that can follow or unfollow an artist. This read still answers the question for artist URIs.

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

uris.description: Spotify URIs to check (accepts tracks, albums, episodes, shows, audiobooks, artists, users, playlists)

name: check_in_library
